description: For every scoped formula \(\varphi\), both \(N^+(\varphi)\) and \(N^-(\varphi)\) are in negation normal form, at the same context size as \(\varphi\).

    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.nnf φ positive)
